structure.layout: Single-column marketing landing page: sticky top nav, centered hero with a framed product video and logo wall, a bento grid of feature cards, a row of 5 use-case cards, 3 photo testimonial cards with a stats strip, a full-width grey CTA band, and a multi-column footer

aesthetics.typography: NotionInter (a custom Inter) for everything: headlines in bold with tight tracking, UI and body text. Lyon Text (serif) only for the testimonial blockquotes and the footer McLuhan quote.
aesthetics.typeScale: Very high contrast: 96px bold H1 (with a 72px pill word), 54px bold section H2s, 42px CTA heading, 22px card headings, 16-18px body, 14px labels/eyebrows, 12px meta text

notes: This is Notion's signature monochrome-plus-blue look. Bold, tight-tracked black Inter headlines sit on white, and a single highlighted word ('Think') goes inside a light-blue rounded pill with a blue dot, like an agent-status chip. Hand-drawn black-ink doodle characters peek from behind the product frame. Product UI appears as faithful miniature Notion screens (kanban, database table, charts, agent chat) on #f9f9f8 bento cards. Testimonials are portrait photos tinted with a duotone in brand red, blue and amber, with serif (Lyon Text) quotes. There are two CTA styles throughout: solid blue #0075de, and light-blue #e6f3fe with #005bab text. The capture shows a cookie consent panel fixed at the bottom right. The logo wall shows as a white strip over the product mockup. Hovering 'Product' opens a mega menu of three illustrated, pastel-tinted feature tiles.
